headline: Captain Sully Inducted into Aviation Hall of Fame
meta_description: 17 years after the Miracle on the Hudson, Captain Sully receives aviation's highest honor and reflects on what truly matters in life.
summary_short: Captain Sully has been inducted into the aviation hall of fame, 17 years after his famous emergency landing on the Hudson River.
body:
Captain Sully has been inducted into the aviation hall of fame, seventeen years after the Miracle on the Hudson made him a household name.

The induction comes as a milestone recognition of a career defined by extraordinary composure under pressure. Yet in receiving this honor, Sully has offered a broader reflection: that life means much more than accolades or singular moments of heroism. His perspective suggests that true legacy extends beyond the dramatic events that capture public attention.

The timing of the hall of fame recognition offers Sully a platform to share this wisdom with a new generation—a reminder that while momentous achievements deserve celebration, the deeper measures of a life well-lived often remain quieter and more personal.
quick_facts: Captain Sully honored 17 years after Miracle on the Hudson
Now inducted into aviation hall of fame
Reflects that life means much more than fame
